dft.text: Mohar Varma is the old-fashioned father of Sita, who has not shed the trappings of his former office as consul and expects her to dress as he wishes and be married advantageously.
He is fooled by a cover story that Sita has an internship, and he approves it and embraces her, not knowing she has left to race.

When intruders paralyze him in his own home and offer him the power to undo the revolution, he toasts with Harshad to Kaladesh restored and asks his old friend Rudra to help put an end to the race by force, accepting a bloody trap at the finish line.
The trap stops the leading teams and reveals Sita as captain, but the coup fails and Mohar is jailed.
